routes.reason: Strong fundamentals and examples, but the cumulative baseline already owns the practical capabilities; only the camera-model reframe survives as a patch.
White adds the exact derivation/proof of a measuring point for arbitrary horizontal directions; patch the existing plane-metrology Pattern rather than duplicate it.
Angular plan/elevation examples reinforce the Norling exact-projection AP and D’Amelio metrology.
Oblique perspective supplies a genuinely deeper metric construction for ascending/descending planes, including auxiliary measuring points and true-length transfer.
Applications of the same plan/oblique machinery; no additional separable capability.
Light-source logic overlaps D’Amelio, while multi-plane and curved-receiver shadow handling materially strengthens the existing AP.
Useful camera/orientation reasoning, but the fixed numeric cone rule is held for modern/mathematical verification and no duplicate foundation card is warranted.
Tipped and vertical mirror constructions generalize the earlier level-plane reflection capability and warrant a new general Pattern.

rationale: White is mixed by design: Review for the established foundation, targeted strengthening where exactness improves existing cards, and Deep PASS for oblique-plane metric construction and arbitrary planar reflections.
